title: Skoropadskyi's Coup
desc:
Due to Oleksandr Ohloblyn's unpopular policies and obvious signs of collaboration with the nazis, in particular, aiding and abetting in racial cleansing-the mass extermination of the Jewish population during World War II in Babyn Yar-and his clear dictatorial tendencies, Danylo Skoropadskyi, a descendant of the last hetman of Ukraine, Pavlo Skoropadsky, with the support of the free Cossack troops and the direct assistance of Stus's United Struggle faction, arrested the elected president on suspicion of treason...

Exactly 46 years ago, on the night of April 29-30, 1918, Pavlo Skoropadskyi also staged a coup against an ineffective government to save Ukraine. It is a strange coincidence, but it seems that fate decided to give Ukraine a reliable pillar of support for society - a hetman.

Now only Danylo will decide the next years of an entire nation that has placed its trust in the hetman. Step by step, plan by plan, brick by brick, Ukraine will rise like a phoenix from the ashes of ruin. The UHS will surpass all other political forces in building a new, strong, globally important Ukrainian Hetmanate!

options.name: Glory to Hetmanate! Long Live Skoropadskyi!

title: Skoropadskyi Strikes Back!
desc:
Dziuba couldn't believe it. The situation had quickly spiraled out of his control. It was all over. He should have foreseen the consequences of starting repressions against the fascists. It was one thing when all failures could be blamed on the controversial Ohloblyn, but it was quite another when it came to a respected general in the army, a hero of the civil war, and Stus's right-hand man.

Taras Bulba-Borovets refused to submit to our repressive policy against despotism in the country, and together with Stus and Danylo Skoropadskyi, they formed a coalition, supported by 80% of our army, and are already demanding in front of the government building on Khreshchatyk in Kyiv that Ivan Dziuba renounce all presidential powers granted to him by the people.

If he agrees to the military's demands, he will face life-long house arrest somewhere in Bila Tserkva, but if he refuses, citing his right to continue performing presidential functions, he will be arrested and imprisoned.So he chose the path of freedom and voluntarily renounced the position of President of the Ukrainian People Republic.

However, when Stus arrived at the parliament to take the oath, Danylo Skoropadskyi appeared with loyal, well-armed units of the "Free Cossacks". He announced to the entire parliament that from now on he would become the Hetman-leader of the new Ukrainian Hetmanate, and anyone who did not agree with this would be immediately thrown out into the street and stripped of all ranks, like useless trash. The first to recognize the new Hetman was General Taras Bulba-Borovets, because he saw in him the energy and salvation that the Ukrainian land had been waiting for so long. Vasyl Stus agreed only on the condition that he be given the status of Prime Minister in the Hetmanate.

options.name: Ukraine was saved from socialism in time

title: The Fate of the Dniester and Bug Administration
desc:
It was a special report for Danylo Skoropadskyi, concerning Transnistria, or more precisely, the occupied part of Vinnytsia and the entire Odessa region, together with the former Moldovan autonomous region of Transnistria within the Ukrainian SSR.

Indeed, these ethnically Ukrainian lands are a strategic hub for trade on the Danube, and the port city of Odessa serves as the most important transport and trade hub in the Black Sea, the importance of which cannot be overestimated.In short, we have acquired a real territorial treasure, and now we are faced with the task of deciding the future fate of these lands right now.

There are two strategies that our ministers have encountered. This region, half destroyed by war, is teeming with rebellious Romanians, Moldovans, Germans, and Greeks who refuse to obey the new authorities. These minorities, which have grown in number over more than two decades of occupation, make up half of the region's population, and we will have to deal with them right now. In another scenario, we will pass these problems on to the Dniester and Bug Administrations so that they can persuade these settlers to live in peace and harmony with Ukrainians, or to move to Romania under the "suitcase-train station-Bucharest" program.

These two options are equally effective, and it is up to Hetman Danylo to decide whether it is better to assimilate the locals into our state and personally restore the region's economy, or to shift this burden onto our puppet government.

options.name: We Will Deal With Romanian Terrorism By Ourselves
Place These Problems on the Shoulders of the Local Administration

title: Final Full Integration of Transnistria
desc:
More than a year after the defeat of the Romanians and Germans in the Transnistrian Civil War, it seems that the local administration has finally managed to pacify the region. All that remains is to consolidate our success, restore the long-lost administrative and territorial apparatus by dividing the region into three provinces within the Hetmanate, and integrate local troops into the Armed Forces of Hetmanate.

Although a small number of Romanian terrorists still remain in the Transnistrian region, information about their cells and places of uncontrolled border crossing with Romania has been provided to us by loyal local residents and the local administration. We expect the region to finally calm down in the coming months.

It's time to build trade ties through Odessa. First, we'll get in touch with Turkey so they give us free passage for trade ships through the Bosphorus Strait, and also with the Italian-Egyptian protectorate so our ships can go through the Suez Canal. From now on, we're part of the global trading community!

options.name: The Port of Odesa Is Now Ukrainian

title: First Time In First Grade
desc:
It was a special and long-awaited day for Petro, because finally, after the reconstruction of the once prestigious elite school in Kyiv, which had been closed for several years, he could continue his education without hindrance.Thanks to the efforts of the local city administration, with state investment, a massive restoration of schools across the country has begun.

Galina, the boy's mother, packed the necessary school supplies into his backpack and gave him a generous allowance for the week to donate to further repairs and purchases of books, Ukrainian literature, and educational textbooks for the school. In these post-war times, decades of occupation have resulted in significant illiteracy among the local population. Although teachers were selected based on passing an exam demonstrating sufficient knowledge of their subject, especially fluency in the Ukrainian language, there were cases of teachers lacking experience compared to teachers in other European countries.Wishing him all the best, Galina asked her son to study so that his father would always be proud of him.

Due to traffic problems, the boy was late to the bus station and ended up being the last to arrive in class. All the other first-graders were already sitting at their desks, and the homeroom teacher was trying to keep the class quiet and orderly until the last pupil arrived. Carefully opening the door to the sunlit classroom and seeing his homeroom teacher, Oksana Volodymyrivna, the boy apologized for being late and expressed his gratitude that the others had waited for him. Oksana Volodymyrivna invited her last pupil to the center of the classroom and said; 

- "Childrens, this is your 14th and last classmate, Petro. Please treat him with respect, kindness, and honor so that our class becomes the friendliest group in our school!

options.name: After that, the Whole Class Eagerly Began to Befriend Petro

title: Support for ROA?
desc:
Since we are currently continuing to work closely with reformist nazis, why not use the same approach with other forces that have dealt with them in the past, such as the ROA(Russian Liberation Army)? At present, we do not have sufficient information about these reformers and do not know their motives, which poses the risk that they may deceive us and drive us into even greater dependence from Germania. At the same time, decisive opposition to their intentions will result in us losing the support of the german elite, so what should we do?

In fact, the hetman was not the only one in this position. ROA general Andrey Vlasov is also in similar conditions in the east, the leader of the russian warlord state, located mostly near Samara city, had to deal with germans most part of post-war period. Danylo, no matter how much he hated the bolsheviks, was ready to compromise with Russian collaborators at a time when it was so necessary for the Hetmanate. Although the general already had one foot in the grave, Vlasov sent a reply from his capital in Samara, agreeing to provide all the details of his flirtations over the years with all supporters of nazi ideology in exchange for comprehensive assistance.

The essence of the agreement is the permanent presence of the Hetmanate volunteer corps in case of wars by the ROA for the unification of Russia. As soon as the ROA unifies Russia, the Hetmanate will be able to recall the volunteer contingent back to Ukraine. In return, former Russian collaborators promise to immediately recognize Ukrainian Hetmanate independence and, after unification, to begin fruitful cooperation aimed at developing a non-german economic sphere of influence in Europe, Asia, and other countries. In addition to this, we should consider the benefits for our newly formed armed forces of studying mountain warfare in the Urals, warfare in the swamps and cold tundras of Siberia, and warfare in conditions of lack of infrastructure in the Far East of Russia.

In Danylo's personal opinion, russian wars for unification with the support of one of the most attractive forces for the hetmanist movement, the ROA, will be beneficial in the long term. Although there are fears in the government that after the death of Vlasov, his successor will not want to confront the Nazis and will ultimately refuse to fulfill the agreements after the unification of Russia. Now all that remains is to weigh all the options and make a final decision...

options.name: ROA are Soldiers, and They Don't Forget the Assistance Provided by Hetmanists During the Wars
The Russian Empires Have Always Acted Against Us, Nothing Will Change After Their Unification

title: Results of the Second Year of the "Breadbasket" Program
desc:
"The new year of our extremely useful program for society continues to develop and exceed our expectations from last year.

The time has come when our Ukrainian individual farmers are able to independently manage their farms and profit from them. Food produced on agricultural land, in villages, and in state cooperatives is sold on the market, and a significant percentage of these transactions goes to the budget. However, the costs of developing agricultural entrepreneurship are not low.

It's also impossible not to notice periodic monthly jumps in inflation, which isn't and won't be stable, so it is necessary to be cautious about investments, possibly limiting them for some time. The problem of increasing ukrainian consumption of grain crops and other foodstuffs is becoming more and more acute. The state's task is to at least maintain parity between food production and consumption, so that it is not necessary to purchase foreign products.

Despite the constant increase in annual consumption demands of the population, our economy continues to grow rapidly. Our ministry has prepared a new action program to combat inflation, but in return we will be forced to reduce state support for agricultural cooperatives."

- With respect to His Excellency the Hetman, Minister of the "BreadBasket" Program, Mykhailo Starozhetskyi.

options.name: "I Approve Your New Action Plan, Reduce Investments If Necessary..."

title: Results of the First Year of the "Breadbasket" Program
desc:
"The first year of consumer spending since the start of state subsidies for the ukrainian agricultural sector has passed, and the first results are already visible. According to statistics, we have improved agricultural production methods, increased our grain reserves, and it appears that they have almost covered all of our national needs.

However, the process of eliminating external influence on our domestic food security sector is still far from its logical conclusion. We hope that in a few years we will be able to fully and, most importantly, independently feed our large and ever-growing population, despite the restrictions of the Second Treaty of the Brest-Litowsk Agreement.

There are many other positive aspects of the state program "BreadBasket". The main one is the increase in local GDP in the regions, which contributes to the growth of the economic power and independence of the Hetmanate. In addition, we can highlight the creation of thousands of new jobs, mainly in villages, as well as the prospects for selling our products to our neighbors, and in a few years, to all of Europe and beyond!

However, we are currently facing difficulties in providing all our citizens with basic necessities, such as insufficient supply of products to remote areas, including Crimea, due to logistical problems. We recommend increasing the size of the garrison on the peninsula due to a new wave of "bread protests" by dissatisfied local radical germans over our prioritization of feeding ukrainians first." 

- With respect to His Excellency the Hetman, Minister of the "BreadBasket" Program, Mykhailo Starozhetskyi.

desc:
"The fifth year of our program marks the beginning of a "golden age" for ukrainian farming. We easily meet the needs of our entire population and earn millions in revenue by trading our products with many European countries. The British Isles, Scandinavia (especially Finland), the Iberian Peninsula, and the Balkans are our regular trading partners, and that's not even the full list!

Our state control over agricultural cooperatives has expanded to entire regions, so we are seeing unprecedented centralization of farming. Farmers and agrarians, although they make significant profits, give half to the state, and the state redirects these funds to increase national and regional GDP. Both sides are satisfied, which creates such a desirable harmony in Ukrainian society!

Next, we plan to expand our trade networks to a global scale. Thanks to the nearly completed construction of a trade hub that will begin in the port of Sevastopol, in a year we will open profitable trade routes with Africa, both Americas, and Asia. In the near future, in just 5-10 years, we will not lag behind the leading countries - the USA or Japan - economically, but will catch up with them! Glory to the Hetmanate, long live Skoropadsky!"

title: Choosing a conflict strategy
desc:
Now we have a unique opportunity to settle scores with hungarian imperialism in the ukrainian carpathian movement. Although it may seem that the separatist movement in Transcarpathia, a region that has been under the total military control of the Hungarian Kingdom for more than 25 years, we have the tools to regain control of our part of the Carpathians.

We now have several cells of Transcarpathian resistance at our disposal, which, since the beginning of the civil war in the RK Ukraine, have managed to cross the border with the General-Government along mountain trails and capture part of the Lviv region, taking full control of Stryi for us. Then thoose fighters engaged in skirmishes with UPA units, found themselves surrounded, and only units of the "Free Cossacks" saved the Transcarpathians. Although few of these brave fighters profess our state ideology, they are loyal to us because we not only saved their lives, but also provided them with refuge in the Hetmanate.

Now it remains to choose a strategy for starting a conflict with Hungary. Mykola Tarnovyi, who has established close relations with the remnants of the Transcarpathian resistance, insists on staging a proxy war, a local war in Hungary, with the aim of preventing the Greater Germanic Reich from intervening in the war. This is a mild version of the conflict, which will not actually affect our civilian and large military population, and we will also have a chance to return Stryi as a result of a chaotic uprising, a situation as chaotic as that which arose for the german administration in Galicia at the beginning of the collapse of the Reich's sphere of influence.

On the other hand, there is another option: to take direct revenge on Hungary for all these years of suffering of Ukrainian Carpathian patriots. We will directly declare a limited military operation to return only Transcarpathia, half of which is populated by Ukrainians. The Germans will intervene, but not directly, because it is more profitable for them to continue to reap the benefits of the Second Brest-Litovsk Agreement and heal the scars of the civil war. This option will be worse for us from a military point of view, including the lack of mountain logistics, heavy casualties due to the narrow front, and the inability to capture the neighboring mountain areas in Galicia controlled by the Germans. Although, in this case, this war may become not only our victory but also the defeat of the Reich on the international arena.

However, whichever option we choose in this direction of expansion, the germans will not silently or only with condemnatory statements tolerate another conflict that threatens what is perhaps their most loyal ally since the end of World War II.

options.name: Accept Tarnovyi proposal - he understands the nature of guerrilla warfare
Hungarian Rats Will Get What They Deserve - Our Revenge!

title: Something big begins with something small
desc:
Now that it is clear that Ukraine has healed its recent scars from civil war, a window of opportunity is opening up in our own backyard. Analyzing the path of the leading superpowers of the Cold War, they gained their influence through participation in global conflicts. Would the japanese have been able to participate in the global battle for the division of humanity if they had not started a war for chinese lands rich in minerals? Practice shows that we will not gain a place under the sun in peace, and although almost half of our population does not want new wars, we will have to start convincing them of the opposite.

Our efforts, as well as state funds, will be focused on convincing Ukrainians who have recently recovered from the war to undergo compulsory service in the armed forces of the Hetmanate and to accustom them to military affairs. First and foremost, they will defend everything that is dear to them, our home, including temporarily uncontrolled territories. Pavlo Skoropadskyi once compared Ukraine without Crimea to a torso without legs. Similarly, Danylo compares Ukraine without Odesa, Transcarpathia , and Kuban to a torso without arms.

We will consider various options for creating new conflicts, but limited to the lands inhabited by Ukrainians, so as not to conflict too much with Bormann's vision of European domination and oppression, at least for now.

options.name: When, If Not Now, Should We Rescue Ukrainians from Occupation?

title: Forced Peace Negotiations
desc: Unfortunately, our forces are unable to break through the fortified positions of the partisans of Transcarpathia. Coupled with the Hetmanate direct funding and supply of weapons to the rebels, and our dwindling stockpiles, we can no longer continue fighting. The Reich has taken the position of a mediator and we have no option to refuse to conduct negotiations that will not be conducted in our favor...

options.name: We lost the battle, but not the war...

title: Self-Government of the Crimean Peninsula?
desc:
At the end of the process of solving the urgent problems of the Crimean peninsula, we renamed Crimea into Gotenland in our legislative system, but this seems to be not enough. Local patriotic germans, who have lived on these lands for more than two decades and make up to 75% of the population of the region, demand the granting of a special autonomous status. In our unitary state, this means a clear border in the management of any other region of ours and Gotland.

Our ukrainian politicians in the parliament demand the simple granting of a compromise autonomous status to Gotenland. This in turn will slow down our overall GDP growth due to the impossibility of fully utilizing all the wealth of the region, it will save us hundreds of millions of funds due to the costs of forming the local administration.

On the other hand, having satisfied all the demands of the germans and in fact presented them with full management of the peninsula, they will give up their claims to control the ports of Sevastopol and Kherson, and will also sign agreements of "eternal friendship and cooperation in all directions" with us. The final choice by hetman Skoropadskyi will be...

options.name: Transfer Control of Gotenland to the Local Loyal German Elite
Just Give Gotenland an Autonomous Status Within the Hetmanate

title: Survive the Transcarpathian Blitz
desc:
With the beginning of the fighting in Transcarpathia, the hungarians are determined to maintain their own control over Transcarpathia. We must prevent their "Transcarpathian Blitz" and force the hungarian authorities to sit down at the negotiating table as soon as possible!

To do this, we will hold a meeting with german diplomats and ministers every week, demanding that they contribute to a peaceful settlement of the conflict. The longer this conflict lasts, the less patience the Führer will have and, as a result, the sooner Hungary will be forced to sit down at the negotiating table with us and the rebels. In the end, with our subversive activities inside the Kingdom of Hungary, combined with the sending of volunteer forces to our transcarpathian brothers and sisters, will allow us to achieve the recognition of the Carpathian-Ukrainian State and its victory in the defensive war!

options.name: It's Necessary to Secure Better Positions for the Rebels ASAP!

title: New Years of the Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate!
desc:
Finally, Hetman Danylo has a free week in his schedule, which he can use for himself. In recent years, with his coming to power at the end of 1964, such moments were rare, because it was necessary to rebuild the country and fight for its glory in the whole world. But, it seems, all this was achieved and finally Danylo could really be proud of himself and the restored and dominant hetmanists movement in society.

The whole country celebrated the reunification of the country under the banner of the Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate, and even the people of Kuban are beginning to believe in a better tomorrow. The New Year of 1972 was the most lavishly celebrated in the last half century, the New Year tree was put up in all district town centers, people caroled for Christmas, all with full stomachs. Indeed, the Ukrainian decade of the 1970s in Eastern Europe has arrived!

The hetmanist affair will not only continue its course, it will be able to develop further even without the direct participation of Danylo. He decided to celebrate the New Year in the ukrainian Carpathians, together with a diaspora of supporters. He began his 5-day vacation with a tour from Ternopil to Ivano-Frankivsk, visiting villages as well. After making sure that the post-war reconstruction was completed in whole western regions, he stayed for a few days in the best luxury hotel in Yaremcha city. On the 3rd day he visited a bathhouse and on the 4th he visited the hot springs near his hotel. Fully satisfied and refreshed by the local service, on the 5th day he went back to the capital Kyiv city.

A festive atmosphere was in the air after he proclaimed the Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate. Not only the capital, the whole country glorified his power, and those small opposition political elements, including Vasyl Stus, were convinced of the hetman's ability to preserve Ukraine, accepting the hetman's cause and joining this movement.

"Would my father be proud of me now, if he were alive, whose work I realized to the fullest extent only now, in the early 1970's?" - Danylo Skoropadskyi said aloud to himself, going to bed.

options.name: Danylo United the Hearts of the Whole Country in the Hetmanist Cause!

title: Danylo's Personality Cult with Unlimited Power
desc:
Hesitating for a long time and considering this step for several months alone, without consulting anyone, Danylo Skoropadskyi decided to obtain unlimited legislative and executive power for himself alone. The threatening international situation and the tense situation in the political space prompt us to take a difficult step. The competition of democratic forces appeared, fed up with military defeats and Hetman's authoritarian-fascist policy in recent years.

Although in general, despite several defeats in proxy conflicts, the army keeps its oath of loyalty to the Ukrainian Hetmanate, despite the protests of civilians, because they believe in Skoropadskyi's ability to skillfully manage and preserve ukrainian statehood, even under the conditions of restrictions on the rights and freedoms of the civilian population, media censorship and the appointment of key ministers at their own discretion. Skoropadskyi relied on this in his decision, concentrating all the levers of Ukrainian Hetmanate management in his hands.

Vasyl Stus, the former right-hand man of the Hetman, announced his disagreement with the concentration of all power in the hands of one person, and together with his supporters in the parliament demanded the abolition of these powers. However, this opposition was detained directly in the parliament by units of the "Free Cossacks". For these dissident actions aimed at harming the hetmanist cause, Vasyl Stus was sent under house arrest with a ban on public and political activities, and other influential supporters of his received prison terms from 1 to 6 years.

The period of dictatorial winter has begun in the Ukrainian Hetmanate, and from now on ukrainians do not know what to expect for tomorrow with the crackdown on demonstrations and peaceful protests.

"Is it worth it, will the ukrainians understand my decision, or will they just distance themselves from me?" - said Danylo Skoropadskyi in his voice, sitting in his office, turning on his radio, trying to calm his nerves with modern ukrainian music.

options.name: It's Necessary to Build a Hetman Cult of Personality

title: Odesa Demonstrations
desc:
Unprecedented events in the authoritarian Hetmanate have sent shockwaves through all national media outlets, including state-run ones, which are subject to strict censorship. News of the events currently unfolding in the country's main commercial port city - Odesa - is spreading rapidly across the information landscape. Despite the region's recent liberation from Romanian occupation, our state is now facing organized protests in the city itself for the first time. The city's status-quo had been maintained all these years, as we invested significant funds in rebuilding the city, which had been destroyed by fighting. And as soon as we restored it, the global oil crisis began, which brought the entire local transportation network to a halt - an unprecedented display of incompetence on the part of the administration we had established. Until then, the mayor of the city was Serhiy Stepanovych Kotenko, who had obtained the position through "connections".

Due to such shenanigans, in the midst of workers' demonstrations - which were attended by the head of government and acting Prime Minister Andriy Bilopolskyi himself - he announced the dismissal of the incompetent minister. A compromise was needed, even with workers who had not been brainwashed by socialist propaganda; they were citizens of the country just like civil servants. Mr. Andriy wanted to be close to the people, even those who were not ideologically loyal, having recently been freed from Romanian domination and a repressive regime. Accordingly, with the intention of resolving the situation and reaching any possible compromises with the demonstrators, the announcement was made regarding the dismissal of Serhiy Kotenko. Half the crowd, upon hearing this, naturally asked:

"And who will fill the vacant position? Another bureaucrat from the distant capital, who couldn't care less about our localproblems?"

This was followed by a decisive response from the minister.

"We have selected for you a candidate who is a skilled sailor and has been living here for a long time - none other than Tsiurupa Pavlo Andriyovych!"

As expected, the crowd was satisfied with the response, since most were aware of Pavlo's charitable efforts to rebuild the city. Additionally, he had visited the city on multiple occasions since the onset of the oil crisis, consulting with industrialists and business leaders, including visits to newly opened factories producing essential goods and light industrial products. The demonstrators generally spoke positively of him and were already satisfied with what they considered to be a sound personnel decision. Some of the protesters' demands regarding expanded local self-government were not met, as the authorities remained concerned about protest sentiment in the region. Of course, there is no longer any question of military control over Odesa and neighboring regions, but all heads of these territories are strictly selected from the Dnieper region of Ukraine. According to various forecasts, a civilian administration drawn from the local population will begin to take shape over the next 8–12 years in order to eliminate the risk of separatism, which has not yet subsided.

options.name: We hope that knowledge of trade and the city will help Pavlo Andriyovych!

title: The Peninsula's Logistics Woes
desc:
As we navigate the most difficult phase of the oil crisis, our Hetmanate faces many challenges of a national nature. While both the west and the east are holding together and helping one another - thanks to the Ministry of Culture - the same cannot be said for the south. A severe socio-economic crisis is unfolding, further exacerbated by rising gasoline and fuel prices, which in turn are complicating transportation links. Our police departments have already received a dozen reports of various crimes, ranging from purely economic to even criminal. Significantly, these crimes are mostly committed by Germans against Ukrainians and Tatars in the region, which further entrenches anti-German sentiment in our society!

And this problem must be addressed by resolving all disputes involving such individuals - especially those of different nationalities - exclusively through the courts. During the oil crisis, our merchant ships and oil tankers stopped sailing through the Azov Sea, which consumes scarce fuel. Transporting thousands of barrels is complicated by infrastructure issues, as the Crimean Peninsula is not as developed as our other regions. In some places, Crimea is not logistically connected to our country at all (the Arabat Spit) due to constant sabotage by the German resistance movement. Given the difficulty of unloading goods in Mykolaiv, which is simply not equipped to handle the scale of cargo unloading we require, we continue to use Sevastopol and Kerch.

First and foremost, the Hetman instructed his government to resolve the logistical issues and to set aside inefficient maritime trade transportation as a low priority. Along with addressing the land transportation and logistics challenges, cultural and educational initiatives will be carried out among the population of the south, following the precedent of successful efforts throughout Ukraine. Above all, we will strive to meet the needs of everyone - the residents of Kherson, Melitopol, Mariupol, and, of course, Crimea itself. To this end, we will artificially lower local fuel prices without reducing the price for the entire country. All these measures will be unfair and financially challenging in the short term and will not help us quickly overcome the oil crisis. However, in the long term - and even in the medium term, within the next year - we will restore the pre-crisis fuel situation, produce more domestic oil, transport it by sea for trade, and, as a result, emerge from the crisis as a more stable country than we were before it!

options.name: Let's lay the groundwork for solving all the current problems!

title: Flights of Foreigners
desc:
As time has passed since the Hetman of all Ukraine assumed dictatorial, unlimited powers, the domestic situation has changed very little. Although Ukrainians managed for a time to unite their efforts to overcome the oil crisis, which affected all segments of society, everything is returning to the way it was. A new wave of protests against The Hetman's Cause is beginning, and the parliament - which until recently was loyal - can no longer smoothly pass new government agendas. Among the significant difficulties, it is worth noting the parliament's refusal to grant expanded powers to the police to disperse riots; such a vote has already been rejected twice.

It should be noted that it is not only our coalition "partners" who are blocking such resolutions, but also our own collaborators - the parliament is not functioning properly. Our law enforcement agencies are unable to forcibly disperse protests, as they lack authorization to do so from both the government and the regional governors. All we are currently doing to counter this new wave of discontent is blocking roads, railways, and airports to prevent protesters from accessing them. Our Armed Forces of the Hetmanate, which remain loyal to the ideals of the Hetmanist Movement, are also increasingly involved in this process.

The country continues to go about its quiet life, but no one knows how long this status quo will last. At the capital's main airport, Boryspil International Airport (which began operating back in 1961, during the German occupation), German workers, businesspeople, and members of the elite are arriving in increasing numbers under quota arrangements. Flying on Lufthansa's reliable Boeing 737-100 aircraft, between 1500 and 7500 such individuals arrive each month, according to various estimates. The Ukrainian Hetmanate does not oppose their voluntary labor, which, according to various estimates, contributes between 2% and 8% of the state's revenue relative to GDP. This is especially true right now, as Ukrainians are striking and refusing to work for their unpopular "sick leader"; such immigration is more than welcome. Consequently, social tensions persist between the native population and the Germans, who, under the quota system, easily take jobs that are a priority for the local population.

Oleksandr Semenko is confident that this positive trend will allow us to catch up with other developed countries, particularly Italy, in terms of standard of living. Flights to the Ukrainian Hetmanate are becoming far more attractive to Europeans than, say, the unpromising Romania or the damp Norway. Meanwhile, Germany's Nazi leadership is becoming increasingly demanding, calling for full visa-free travel for its citizens and the opening of all the Hetmanate's borders with other Reichskommissariats. So far, however, this has been met with inaction - in fact, paralysis - on the part of the hetmanist government, which continues to suffer from a political crisis.

In the new decade, even though the oil crisis has finally been overcome, the Hetman's followers face dozens, if not hundreds, of new challenges. Everyone understands that if the Hetman does not personally resolve some of the most difficult ones and does not abolish at least some of his unlimited dictatorial powers, there will be a split in society.

options.name: A divided Ukraine is a blessing and a gift to our rivals.

title: Yalta Summit
desc:
In order to strengthen ties with the Russian Republic - which was established in the territory of the former Russian Anarchy, not without our help, of course - we held the Yalta Summit. Officially, it is a non-political platform for concluding mutually beneficial agreements and establishing trade relations with the countries of Central Asia and Russia. But in reality, this event will likely be a defining moment in the new Eurasian geopolitics. As the Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate drifts further and further away from the Reich's sphere of influence, this poses many risks to our security. We must not be left alone to face this savage beast, for all our efforts to strengthen Ukraine's position must not be in vain!

Alongside several delegations from Central Asia - including representatives of the Kazakh anti-Bolshevik intelligentsia - a significant delegation from the Russian Republic was also present. With Russia's recent unification - which took place just a decade ago - they cast a shadow over all the other summit participants. The Russians are represented by Georgy Zhilenikov - Bunyachenko's right-hand man and trusted confidant - who did not arrive here by chance. The Russian Liberation Army remembers the assistance provided by the Hetmanist forces during such critical times of active and persistent efforts to reunify Russia. Following their success, President [SAM.GetLeader] has indeed decided to honor the terms of bilateral commitments and is inviting our country to join the Collective Security Bloc! Here is the letter the Hetman personally received from him:

"I wish good health to His Excellency the Hetman, and to my unquestionable ally in the anti-Bolshevik struggle, [FUK.GetLeader]! I am writing to you to express my gratitude for your timely and vital assistance and for the contribution your Hetmanist Movement has made to the unification of Russia. We are ready to fulfill the obligations entrusted to us: to recognize your Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate within its current borders, to continue working closely together to overcome the dominant Unity Pact in Europe, and to admit you into the Collective Security Bloc at the earliest opportunity! Furthermore, my Prime Minister Zhilenikov has been briefed on the relevant instructions and will formally accept any declarations of friendship and strategic partnership for an indefinite term from your side at the official level. May the historic friendship between White Russia and the centralized Ukraine endure forever with the defeat of the Nazi scourge in Europe and Asia, wherever they may be. Glory to Russia and the Hetmanate!" - the end of [SAM.GetLeader]'s personal letter. After rereading it, Danylo called Bilopolskyi, who happened to be at the Yalta summit at that very moment.

The Hetman did not want to make the same mistake again, for he knew the reasons behind the Whites' defeat in the former Russian Civil War. Even today, not all of the army - nor even the generals of the Russian Liberation Army - viewed the existence of an independent Ukraine favorably. But the current realities were simply pushing both sides toward an understanding. The coming years would be decisive for all of Europe; all the Hetman's men understood this after the proclamation of the Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate. The question was framed differently: "What if the Reich strikes the Hetmanate first?" or "What if the Russia loses again, will we be left alone after that against the Nazi eagle in a helpless situation?"

In any case, the minister was on the phone, awaiting Danylo's final decision. Having gathered his strength to once again recount the tragic history of cooperation with the Russians, and guided first and foremost by the interests of Ukrainian statehood, the order was given...

options.name: ..."We won't let this historic opportunity slip by - we'll liberate Europe together with the Russians!"
..."It would be a mistake to hold a second 'Pereyaslav Agreement' - let's not sign anything!"

title: Cossacks in the High Castle
desc:
Stores and businesses were open, the metallurgical and industrial sectors were producing materials, and the population and the army were working to ensure the stability of the Hetmanate. A little over eight years have passed since the Hetmanist Coup, and the scent of a new war is closer than ever. Just as we did seven years ago, we risk once again finding ourselves in a stalemate against the Greater Germanic Reich, which dominates Europe. Just like the weak and lone David against the mighty Goliath...

But that is not the case; our Ukrainian people are confident: if the Reich and Führer [GER.GetLeader] have not yet attacked us, it means they lack the strength to do so. The Nazis understand that if they dare to do so, it would directly threaten their food security. Under the Second Treaty of Brest-Litowsk, we continue to supply them with food in exchange for peace between our two countries. This is a kind of precautionary - and, in some ways, manipulative - tool in bilateral relations, used by both sides. It is not 100% beneficial to anyone, so its continued existence in its current form is impossible. Although German bureaucrats are trying to find alternative sources of food - such as the vast expanse of France - everything ultimately comes down to Ukraine's fertile black soil.

But our Ukrainian agricultural sector is not standing still; it, too, is constantly improving. The full mechanization of agriculture is already 75% complete, and our diplomats are successfully introducing the latest Japanese technologies to boost agricultural production. Our fields are more productive than ever; perhaps this is what is currently preventing the Wehrmacht from destroying its former "Breadbasket" in the flames of destructive war. But that is the situation as of today, for with the unification of Russia and the conflicts in France, more and more new threats are emerging for the German New Order. The world does not stand still, unlike the Reich, so we have every chance of defeating Goliath; we just need to wait for the right moment - or strike first, without waiting for a response from Germania.

In the coming year, [FUK.GetLeader] must find as many partners and allies for Ukraine as possible if he plans to preserve Ukrainian statehood. After all, a future large-scale war is no longer a mere possibility - it is a fully realistic scenario for the Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate. If the Hetman's followers seek to save their homeland from destruction, they will either become even stronger than they were yesterday, or they will be perish - along with independent Ukraine - perhaps forever...

options.name: Despite everything, we will continue to fight, just as our Cossack ancestors did.

title: Panic Over a Raging Fire in the East
desc:
Most national news programs are broadcasting shocking reports about a new crisis in the east. What began as rumors and inconclusive intelligence reports from the Reichskommissariat Moskowien authorities has finally made waves across Europe, particularly in Ukraine. The news is simple, yet terrifying - the Russians are amassing massive, colossal armed forces along the German-Russian border.

Amid the hysteria within the Pact, a massive, uncontrolled exodus of civilians - and in some cases even soldiers - has begun from the Reichskommissariat Moskowien toward the west, away from the threatening eastern neighbor. Since we are a member of the Unity Pact and are practically on the front lines of the escalating conflict instigated by the militaristic [RUS.GetName], many members of the Hetmanist government are considering immediate measures. Although we have reaped considerable benefits for the country from our membership in the Unity Pact, a potential Second West Russian War could shape the future and open a new chapter for Eastern Europe.

The choice now is what position we will take in this inevitable, bloody war. After all, if we remain within the German sphere of influence, we risk being directly drawn into the eastern meat grinder. And given the numerous losses already suffered by the current generation of Ukrainians, it would be better to stay on the sidelines. This is Hetman's view; however, many military leaders warn of the danger of a second betrayal of the Germans - which Germania will certainly not forgive. Moreover, we must take into account that this will be a war between nuclear powers, so each side will destroy anyone who is directly on the enemy's side. Therefore, by choosing neutrality and betraying the Germans, we will be left on our own, surrounded by enemies - both the eastern barbarians and the beasts from the west.

options.name: It's better to safeguard our future against the risk of another Russian occupation...
This isn't our war, and Germania certainly won't force it on us - not this time!

title: Our Transcarpathian Victory!
desc:
Ukrainian rebels in Transcarpathia have secured control over all Ukrainian villages, cities and mountains, ready for further integration with the homeland! The leader of the insurgents, our general Mykola Tarnovyi, is joyfully greeted at Khreschatyk in the capital with a military victory parade. There are already plans to promote him to the role of field marshal for such a great victory.

Indeed, it is difficult to overestimate our successful operation to return such a distant and long-forgotten ukrainian region. The germans, and especially the hungarians, were already sure that this region would never be ukrainian again, but we proved the opposite, proving to the whole world that despite the present, we remember our past roots, past generations, and all the unsuccessful attempts to build ukrainian statehood. Let this serve as a lesson that we will not put up with any manifestations of oppression of ukrainians near our borders!

options.name: Transcarpathia is a Part of Ukraine From Now On And Forever!

title: Categorical refusal
desc:
Bormann refuses to return the western Ukrainian lands, demanding the return of the few we gained during the civil war...

Another sad page in the history of Ukraine over the last decade, which generally means the continuation of the division of the Ukrainian people by various empires. Judging by the news, this ‘curse' will remain with us in the future, as Martin Bormann continues the traditional policy of ‘divide and rule' based on intimidation and humiliation of the ethnic peoples of Europe to ensure the dominance of his thousand-year Reich. The worst thing is that we are left with no choice but to leave our western Ukrainian lands in exchange for regaining control over Brest-Litovsk and... illusory economic prospects from fulfilling the ultimatum.

Although today we have lost about 15% of our territory (including possible control over Transcarpathian Ukraine), we must not lose faith in the Hetman's ability to restore historical justice tomorrow. We will wait several years, decades, or even centuries for the unification of Ukrainians into one state. The Ukrainian Hetmanate will continue to exist and improve in all areas!

options.name: A dark chapter for the newly divided Ukrainian nation...

title: Strained compromise
desc:
After decades of occupation, parts of western Ukraine were liberated during the Ukrainian Civil War and came under the control of the Ukrainian People's Republic, and now the Hetmanate. The Poles retained control of Lviv and its surroundings, but Bormann corrected this by force of arms.

Poland had no chance of maintaining its independence, but we can. In the case of the conservative Führer of the Greater Germanic Reich, Bormann, we cannot keep all of Galicia. Germany demands the surrender of Galicia, but we will resort to trickery in this case. We know what is really behind these demands - access to the region's mineral resources. Therefore, we will grant the right to extract resources in Galicia by concluding an agreement on mineral resources, dividing Galicia in half, with the eastern part, including Ternopil, remaining ours.

options.name: Reich doesn't care about slaves, how typical...

title: Managemant Problems
desc: After decades of Nazi rule, Ukraine's administrative apparatus remained in a state of disrepair. Following the flight of key corrupt regional officials after the Hetman coup, we were left with administrators who created an extraordinary administrative burden. In essence, we hold power thanks to the forces of the militarized "Free Cossacks" and a political coalition with Stus's patriots and a small number of Dziuba's supporters. Our hetmanate is saved from collapse by the population's fatigue from the civil war, as well as the prestige of Danylo Skoropadskyi in the eyes of the common people, who are tired of the empty talk of the communists, hatred of the Nazis, and the decline of the local nationalist sentiments.

options.name: Let's deal with all the problems one by one.

title: The Problem of Shumsky's Partisans
desc:
To our surprise, the national-bolsheviks, who had been rebuilding the country throughout the years of nazi occupation and who had suffered a crushing defeat in the Ukrainian Civil War, began an underground resistance movement.

Even without their leader, they continue their subversive activities against the established Hetmanate, spreading their propaganda among the working class, agitating them to resist the new government and fight for workers' rights.We must deploy the newly formed State Guard ( SG ) security forces to combat this threat before the fire of revolution aimed at overthrowing our legitimate government plunges Donbas into yet another bloody uprising.

options.name: Isn't Bolshevism a Relic of the Past?

title: The Long-Awaited Fruits of Oil Autarky
desc:
The oil crisis, which has plagued politicians all over the world for almost a year, has had a strong impact on our country. Our government obediently accepted all the Hetman's proposals to introduce a ban on the sale of oil and increase domestic oil production in all areas where possible. The crisis has temporarily slowed down our GDP growth and has also sufficiently depleted our fuel resources.

Now, it seems, we have gone from a deficit to a surplus, our neighbors, although wary of us, pragmatically buy our oil, which is in surplus. Although it will take a long time to fully recover, we are sure that we have now succeeded in our mission - to start successful ukrainian oil autarky.

options.name: We Live Not For Tomorrow, But For Today

title: Propose holding a plebiscite in western Ukrainian lands
desc:
After decades of occupation of our ethnic western lands, it is our duty to the people to return them, because now there is a wonderful opportunity to do so! Ukraine is independent, has an army and good relations with the reformator leader of the Greater Germanic Reich, Albert Speer, who pursues a humane policy towards the indigenous peoples of Europe, giving them the right to limited control over their own state.

There are many nuances, but the hetman has already begun consultations and rounds of negotiations with the Germans on holding a plebiscite to decide the future fate of Galicia. Of course, we are not stupid, and we understand how much this process will cost, but can the further suffering of the Ukrainians of Galicia be measured in monetary terms?.

options.name: Without germans and poles, decent future for ordinary Galicians will be guaranteed!

title: The Question of the Galician lands
desc:
It seems that the dust has settled in Europe, the wars are over, and the borders have almost returned to what they were before the long conflicts that followed the collapse of the Reich. A few months ago, Bormann sent the rebuilt Wehrmacht to capture independent Poland, which fell within a week.

We need to send our delegation to Germany as soon as possible, before the Führer starts considering the Ukrainian question. The Hetman strictly ordered that all possible and impossible methods be used to appease Martin and beg for more favorable terms for the future of Galicia.

options.name: Let's hope Martin Bormann is willing to cooperate...

title: The beginning of Europeanization
desc:
Due to the security guaranteed to us by Führer Speer and a bright European future, we are not going to pave the way for an independent Ukrainian Hetmanate that would compete with the world's superpowers. Instead, we will focus on internal development to preserve our peaceful future, without conflicts and bloodshed for future generations of Ukrainians.

We have lost enough millions of our compatriots in bloody wars, we have conquered enough land, that is more than enough for us! For peace and prosperity in Ukraine and Europe! Sieg Speer!

title: Cossack Path
desc:
After decades of oppression, first by the Bolsheviks and later by the Germans, Ukraine found itself in a second era of ruin, similar to the second half of the 17th century. But now everything has been turned upside down, and Ukraine has taken second place in importance in the Unity Pact, after the Reich. Nevertheless, our ambitions extend far beyond this pitiful alliance of peoples subjugated by the Germans.

Although we cannot directly challenge Führer Bormann militarily, we will begin to undermine the Reich from within his sphere of influence. At first, we will play along with the Führer's policies, feigning calm and fulfilling our obligations as an ally. In reality, we will begin genuine subversive activities within the Reich, ultimately leaving the stronghold of Europe without support.

Of course, all this will be done in secret, and we will lie about all claims from Germania. In the end, the Reich's military machine will not be able to live in peace and will go to war with another state. Only then, when we are fully prepared and the Reich is left alone, will we deliver the final blow to the rotten, dark empire of evil, liberating Europe. We will not forget the legacy left to us by Hetman Ivan Mazepa and the example of the necessary struggle for the liberation of entire peoples of Europe. In the end, the slogan of the nationalists cossacks will also be heard in Germania...

options.name: "Those Who Struggle Will Win the World!"

title: Permission to hold a plebiscite
desc:
With the successful approval of our generous proposal to hold a "plebiscite" in Galicia, our efforts have brought about the first diplomatic victory in the policy of reuniting our great homeland into a single state!

Purely formal diplomatic efforts are beginning to hold an international summit in Lemberg, as well as to organize a referendum throughout Galicia (including the eastern part under our control).All member states of the Unity Pact will be present at this summit, including the English collaborators invited by the German side, as well as members of the former Triumvirate invited by us.The referendum itself lasted three days, with a turnout of 78%. 71.6% of the total population voted for reunification with the Ukrainian Hetmanate, with the most positive results in the Ternopil region, which we control, at 94%, and the worst in the city of Lviv at 19%. 23.4% voted against reunification, and 5% of the population abstained. European independent observers did not notice any violations in the referendum, so they are recognized as legitimate and conducted without violations.

A number of countries, including the Greater Germanic Reich, recognized the plebiscite as legally valid and gave their unequivocal consent to the transfer of these lands to the Ukrainian Hetmanate. Only the Reich Protectorate of Poland, the Kingdom of Hungary, Iberia, and the Reichskommissariat Moskowien disagreed with the results of the plebiscite.In a matter of days, all powers of the Polish-Nazi administration of Western Galicia will be transferred to the Ukrainian administration. This is a great victory for the Hetman government and a significant event in the modern history of Ukraine!

However, much to the disappointment of Hetman Danylo, Albert Speer rejected his personal request to transfer control of the Brest-Litowsk region to the Ukrainian Hetmanate, thereby eliminating the Reichskommissariat Ukraine, which we detest. It appears that Speer wishes to maintain the status of a divided Ukraine in order to ensure national problems for us in the future.

options.name: Now the history of Galicia and Ukrainian Hetmanate are forever linked

title: Permission to hold a plebiscite and further concessions
desc:
With the successful approval of our generous proposal to hold a "plebiscite" in Galicia, our efforts have brought about the first diplomatic victory in the policy of reuniting our great homeland into a single state!

Purely formal diplomatic efforts are beginning to hold an international summit in Lemberg, as well as to organize a referendum throughout Galicia (including the eastern part under our control).All member states of the Unity Pact will be present at this summit, including the English collaborators invited by the German side, as well as members of the former Triumvirate invited by us.The referendum itself lasted three days, with a turnout of 78%. 71.6% of the total population voted for reunification with the Ukrainian Hetmanate, with the most positive results in the Ternopil region, which we control, at 94%, and the worst in the city of Lviv at 19%. 23.4% voted against reunification, and 5% of the population abstained. European independent observers did not notice any violations in the referendum, so they are recognized as legitimate and conducted without violations.

A number of countries, including the Greater Germanic Reich, recognized the plebiscite as legally valid and gave their unequivocal consent to the transfer of these lands to the Ukrainian Hetmanate. Only the Reich Protectorate of Poland, the Kingdom of Hungary, Iberia, and the Reichskommissariat Moskowien disagreed with the results of the plebiscite.In a matter of days, all powers of the Polish-Nazi administration of Western Galicia will be transferred to the Ukrainian administration. This is a great victory for the Hetman government and a significant event in the modern history of Ukraine!

Moreover, Speer decided to abolish the rotten Reichskommissariat Ukraine and annex the Brest-Litowsk region to our Hetmanate. We are grateful for this decision and will continue to pay additional revenues into the Reich's coffers for its generosity.

options.name: Now the history of Galicia and united Ukrainian Hetmanate are forever linked

title: Chaos in Odessa
desc:
A coordinated group of Ukrainian nationalists carried out the largest terrorist attack since the end of World War II, killing the military governor of Transnistria.

In response, Romanian troops occupied the region with the aim of stabilizing the situation and imposed martial law. It is now clear that this is our only chance to regain occupied Transnistria.Since the Germans have declared their full support for Romania's efforts, only we are in a position to save the rebels from the complete destruction of everything Ukrainian in the region.

We will disguise our volunteer forces as rebels and send as many weapons as necessary to reach Odessa. We currently have the upper hand, as the rebels number in the tens of thousands, so if we manage to overcome the enemy's tank and helicopter forces in Transnistria, the rebels will win!

options.name: Hang in There, Brothers, We're Coming to Help You Soon!

title: Plans for Domestic Production
desc:
During the reform of our air force structure, we faced the urgent problem of a lack of domestic aircraft. The soviet, pre-war aircraft we had are outdated and cannot keep up with the times, lagging behind by more than a decade. Currently, all of our aircraft are based on german models of the 1950s, purchased recently.

Our pilots insist on increasing funding for the production of domestic aircraft for our air force. These aircraft are manufactured in ukrainian design bureaus based on advanced german aircraft. However, our financiers, who have barely recovered from the increase in funding for the ground forces, are opposed to increased funding.

Our budget is not elastic, and in the near future, our economy will not be able to compete with superpowers in terms of funding the armed forces. In the end, if you want to improve something, you have to neglect something else...

options.name: Leave Everything at the Current Level

title: Priorities of Fleet Construction Financing
desc:
With a significant share of our spending on fleet building, the question arose of the feasibility of meeting these expenses. On the one hand, our new class of ukrainian sailors requires leaving the current costs for fleet building. No one knows what will happen tomorrow, if Turkey suddenly declares war on us, for example, we will be completely destroyed at sea due to the small number of ships. This position is completely justified, because in the future rivalry with the nazis, their Kriegsmarine will be able, by putting pressure on Turkey, to pass into the Black Sea and start shelling our coast.

However, this could be simple paranoia among sailors due to our difficult relationship with the germans. Our politicians demand to listen to the financiers, who strongly recommend cutting spending on the fleet, as this will cause a large budget deficit in the long term.

options.name: We Will Have the Most Formidable Naval Force in the Black Sea!
It is Better to Save the Budget at Least on the Fleet

title: The Start of Military Battles in Transnistria
desc:
The rebels broke through to Balta, which marks the beginning of military operations within Transnistria. The Reich and Romania began sending their forces to the German garrison in Odessa, and we will do the same, only by fully assisting the rebels. Since the future ownership of the key Black Sea port of Odessa is at stake, the Ukrainian rebels must win.

Because if they lose, Odessa will never be Ukrainian again.

title: Complete Loss of Control of RK Kaukasien Over Azerbaijan
desc:
So, Azerbaijan is rising with our help, this is a great success! For the most part, this was facilitated by the oil crisis, which drove the Kaukasus into a deep national crisis, as a result of which the slave population broke the long-term shackles based on forced labor for the benefit of the hated Reich. Our task is to contribute in any way to ensuring the victory of azerbaijanis in their struggle for liberation!

Also, we observe the current lack of interest on the part of other superpowers in the Kaukasian War. Whether it is due to economic troubles due to the crisis, or purely out of fear of the defeat of a single Azerbaijani uprising against the entire Reichskommissariat, official Washington and Tokyo do not comment on this uprising in any way. Therefore, it is only in our national interests to ensure the weakening of the Reichskommissariat in the region and to halve oil production by the Unity Pact for the viability of the Reich's military capabilities.

options.name: Piece by Piece And the Rotten Structure Will Fall!

title: The Collapse of the RK Kaukasien Due to Mass Uprisings
desc:
What happened was what the entire ethnic population of the Caucasus was waiting for - their hated Reichskommissariat began to fall apart. This is their chance to regain their long-lost independence, and we will help them with that. Georgians and azerbaijanis put up a full-fledged fight. We could start helping them both, but the americans have clearly outlined their interest in helping Azerbaijan, and we, in turn, will provide help to rebel Georgia, with which our ideological interests coincide.

To our great surprise, Japan, with whom we maintained good relations since the confrontation with Hungary over Transcarpathia, decided to help the Germans in suppressing the uprisings. They are clearly acting for pragmatic purposes, let's hope this will not affect the strengthening of the RK position in the region and will not result in the defeat of the uprisings.

options.name: If that Doesn't Destroy RK, What Will?

title: Triumph in Transnistria
desc:
Our volunteers are returning to their homeland in Mykolaiv, confirming the rebels complete victory in the war. This event was celebrated throughout the country, from Volhynia to Rostov, because for the first time since 1941, Ukrainians were in control of the port city of Odesa and other liberated cities in Transnistria.

This victory is followed by a long process of rebuilding the economically devastated region, planning its inclusion in our unified Ukrainian Hetmanate, and resolving ethnic issues that have accumulated significantly over the last decade in the region.Added to this are the fates of tens of thousands of prisoners of war, who are now of direct interest to delegations from the Greater Germanic Reich and the Kingdom of Romania.

Although the Ukrainian population of Transnistria is optimistic and helping to rebuild the devastated region, the process promises to be long and difficult, as there are still large pockets of romanian-moldovan population that continue to sabotage Ukrainian authority in the region, even though they do not pose a significant threat to the new government. They need to be dealt with now, so we will send all the necessary resources to the Dniester and Bug Administration.

options.name: This is how the Winner Judges the Losers

title: A Bitter Defeat in Transnistria
desc:
Due to our limited military capabilities to compete with the Germans in helicopter and tank technologies, we were forced to recognize the sovereignty of the German military garrison in Odesa.

The most we could gain from this unfortunate situation would be to send troops into the part of the Vinnytsia region occupied by the Romanians since the end of World War II-Mohyliv.The base where the uprising actually began is now completely destroyed by the war, and it seems that the Germans are not opposed to the annexation of this bombed-out part of Transnistria, as they have not yet expressed any claims or condemnations regarding the change in the border.

However, the main goal of this proxy war has not been achieved-to regain control of the port city of Odessa, which, judging by all appearances, will not return to us.

title: Plebiszit in Galizien?
desc:
On this ordinary working morning, Albert Speer, Führer of the Greater Germanic Reich, pored over a report sent by his diplomats from Kyiv. Yes, that's right, Skoropadsky's Hetman government had requested a "plebiscite" in Galicia. In reality, it was offering billions of marks in exchange for the transfer of Galicia, granting it autonomous status with free and unrestricted activity for German megacorporations.

Although this decision would undoubtedly allow us to finance the rapid restoration of the country and get rid of the scars of war in the short term, Speyer understood the risks of agreeing to such a "plebiscite".These hetmans may perceive this as both weakness and mercy. However, by agreeing to these conditions, we will be able to lull the belligerence of these cossacks and get rid of the hidden hostile sentiments of Ukrainian slaves with one concession. The rebels have shown how easily they can overthrow our local administrations during any German crisis. In addition, the transfer of all of Galicia to the Ukrainians, which the crushed Poles still claim, will allow us to further quarrel these two nations and distance ourselves from their hatred towards us.In this way, we will get rid of ethnic problems in the Reich.

However, the Führer's report contained another request from Danylo Skoropadskyi himself. In an additional letter, he pledged to continue payments for Galicia and the remnants of the Reichskommissariat Ukraine, because, in his words, "Ukraine, as a European state, should not be divided between two competing governments".Albert did not know how to respond to this request. A week passed, and all of his reichsministers asked him to refuse Skoropadsky's request to transfer Brest, but why mistakenly cling to something that had proven unviable without the help of the Reich?If the Reichskommissariat turned out to be such a corrupt structure that it failed to suppress poorly armed rebels, what would prevent those same rebels from finishing what they had started and finally eliminating the remnants of the Reichskommissariat Ukraine?The final answer remains with the new Führer himself.

options.name: There is no point in clinging to corrupt, rotten institutions. Grant all requests from the Hetmanate.
Let Brest-Litowsk remain a point of influence on Kyiv!

title: The question of the Galician lands
desc:
This morning, a letter from the self-proclaimed "hetman" of Ukraine was delivered to the Führer's office. After Martin opened it, he immediately thought it was some kind of bad joke, but after reading the demands, he understood the situation. The Ukrainians, who during the state of emergency in the Reich, without permission, seized the territories of our protectorate - the General Government in Galicia, want to keep the lands they have gained!

- "It's amazing where the slaves found the courage to demand recognition of their right to control the territory of the Reich. It's just mind-boggling..." Bormann's philosophy was interrupted by Walter Hewel, Hitler's former foreign minister, who came in to ask if everything was all right because of the loud noise.

- "My Führer, is everything all right? What surprised you so much?"

- "Ah, it's you, Walter. Here, read these fables. They're from the ukrainian "hetman". Can you believe it?"

- "So they've decided to become something like a second Reichskommissariat named "Hetmanate"? That's interesting, I don't see any reason to refuse. I advise you to discuss this with the Minister of Economy. We don't need slaves from lands so far away, but their resources..."

- "Actually, I wanted to write a refusal to teach them a lesson and show them that no slave dares to set conditions for revising the territories of the Thousand-Year Reich! However, I think your opinion is also valid, I will ask the Reichsminister what he thinks about it, thank you very much for your advice Walther Hewel."

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Transnistrian Martial Law
desc:
It seems that Ukrainian nationalists, who almost destroyed Romania's puppet state of Transnistria a few years ago, have now successfully killed the local military governor with explosives planted in his car.

Reports have already begun to emerge that local partisans have seized power on the border region near the Hetmanate - Mohyliv, formed a provisional government - the "Council" or "Rada" - and declared that they will fight until the Romanian administration is completely expelled from the region.

Romania, in turn,declared martial law in Transnistria, sent its troops to Odesa and other areas to weaken the rebels as much as possible.German forces are also participating in clearing the region of insurgents.

options.name: It seems that the start of military operations in Transnistria is inevitable

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Ukrainian Rebels Win in Transnistria
desc:
Unexpectedly for international observers, Ukrainian rebels won the Transnistrian Civil War. Despite military support from the Reich and Romania, the German military garrison in Odesa collapsed, as the last forces hostile to the Ukrainian population were cleared out of the city. It can now be said with certainty: "Odesa is Ukraian".

The Kingdom of Romania may now face a protracted political crisis, while the Greater Germanic Reich has declared that it does not recognize the statehood of the so-called "Dniester and Bug Administration" and demands from the Ukrainian Hetmanate "respect the borders established at the end of World War II".

Official Kyiv has refrained from commenting on the current situation and stated that "the population of the region has chosen a future in the Ukrainian Hetmanate, rather than oppression and political persecution in the Kingdom of Romania".

options.name: Ukraine has regained control over all its ports in the Black Sea.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Victory of the German Garrison in the Transnistria
desc:
Official communiques from Bucharest have confirmed what most have suspected for a while after collapse of Transnistrian government as the Romanian government has announced its evacuation of the Transnistrian territory.International observers were not surprised by the reasons for this, as it was the result of a violent and uncontrolled uprising by the Ukrainian population in the region.

The future of the former governorate is that of further Reich control as Romania transfers its responsibilities to the German administration, ruled under the control of military man Siegfried Haß.Siegfried has already announced the start of "cleansing the region of disloyal elements by force of arms", which in reality means the total end of Ukrainian ambitions to control the Odesa region.

Officially, Kyiv, under the guise of "helping to restore stability", annexed a region that belonged entirely to the rebels at the start of the conflict. The Reich remains silent on this issue.

options.name: The Hetmanate got a Beating in Transnistria

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Coup Of Danylo Skoropadskyi
desc:
After the unpopular politician and collaborator of the previous Nazi administration, Oleksandr Ohloblyn, unexpectedly won the rigged first elections in Ukraine's history, ukrainians took to the streets in protests and demonstrations against the unpopular new government.In parallel with the mass protests, many military personnel joined the population, inspired by the political coalition formed between the United Struggle and the UHS, and began an open rebellion, also refusing to recognize the elections.

As a result of this political upheaval, Ohloblyn was arrested by Free Cossack units, and Pavlo Skoropadskyi's successor, Danylo Skoropadskyi, was elected the new leader of the state, with the title of hetman.The coup was condemned by the Reich, which had high hopes for easy submission from the presidential administration, but now it seems the germans will face resistance to their desire to be tied to the former breadbasket.

options.name: Breadbasket of the Reich Is Now a Standalone Player?

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Dziuba Resigns From Presidency
desc:
Breaking news from Kyiv, the capital of the Ukrainian People's Republic, President Ivan Dziuba, successfully elected by the people in the country's first elections, has signed a resignation under pressure from the military.After an unsuccessful attempt to arrest the popular general Taras Bulba-Borovets, the right hand of Vasyl Stus from United Struggle, president provoked the overthrow of his government.

It`s also reported that units of the "Free Cossacks", led by Danylo Skoropadskyi, acted preemptively and managed to arrive at parliament before the end of the ceremony electing Vasyl Stus as the new president, which resulted in the establishment of the Third Hetmanate.

The new hetmanate announced that the elections, as well as democratic processes in the country, would be suspended indefinitely. The US government condemned this coup, which had hoped for the flourishing of what might be Europe's last democracy and wanted to establish diplomatic relations with the Ukrainian People's Republic.

options.name: This is how socialist democracies die

title: [Get_newspaper_header]The Start of Transcarpathian Blitz!
desc:
The recent terror of the hungarian authorities against the renewed ukrainian dissident movement in Transcarpathia, which was accompanied by physical violence against the ukrainian minority, led to an uprising in the region! The hungarian government started the "Transcarpathian Blitz" operation, which aims to completely suppress the Transcarpathian rebels in a matter of weeks.

The rebels were led by the partisan general Mykola Tarnovyi, which indicates the indirect involvement of the Ukrainian Hetmanate in the uprising. The Greater Germanic Reich took a wait-and-see position, official Germania calls on both sides to sit down at the negotiating table to prevent further escalation of the conflict.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Hetmanate Revenge for Transcarpathia!
desc:
The hetmanists government announced a "Special Liberation Operation" against Hungary aimed at liberating Transcarpathia, which has been under the control of the Kingdom of Hungary since 1939. Ukrainians expect to end the war, which, according to military experts, may drag on in 2-3 weeks.

German diplomats condemned this invasion, calling it "barbaric" and one that would violate the European New Order that had been formed since the end of the West Russian War. Skoropadskyi said that until the hungarians agreed to accept the terms of the Hetmanate, the war would continue. The hungarians, on the other hand, hope for decisive action from Germania to end hostilities.

title: [Get_newspaper_header]Azerbaijanis Rose Up in Rebellion!
desc:
Throughout the Unity Pact, there are alarming news from the most unstable Reichskommissariat Kaukasien about a rebellion that turned into an organized Azerbaijani uprising! The authorities of the Reichskommissariat announced a general mobilization and imposed martial law, beginning a brutal suppression of the resistance of the local population. At that time, azerbaijanis are fighting to the last breath for the restoration of their statehood.

The Azerbaijani cause is supported diplomatically by the US government, and militarily by the Ukrainian Hetmanate, which shocked Germania bureaucrats and politicians. Now it is already clear the impossibility of further warm relations between the Greater Germanic Reich and the Hetmanate, because from this moment they are now rivals in the Cold War.
